conform:Error:proposal:01a07ccc-a5ed-7061-8e97-976c0ca44ce6:Filter-matching logic in lib/poll.js is intentionally duplicated across two functions -- matchesFilter() (in-memory, used by the daemon's in-process broadcast path) and buildFilterSql() (SQL LIKE-based, used by poll()'s query) -- and both must be kept semantically identical. Any change to wildcard semantics (single-level 'prefix.*' vs multi-level 'prefix.**' vs catch-all '*', or the domain '@domain' suffix) must be applied to both functions, including buildFilterSql's ESCAPE '\\' handling for literal '_'/'%'/'\\' inside event_type prefixes.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cd0-fabf-7403-b7ab-ed1f898455a9:Never add crates/wicked-core-ts to the root Cargo.toml [workspace].members list (or otherwise fold it into the main cargo workspace). It must stay in the workspace's `exclude` list.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cd5-df93-73b2-a84d-820432495ba0:Any code that spawns npm or npx (or the wicked-garden bin) on Windows must set { shell: true } on spawnSync AND cmd.exe-quote every argument (see winQuote() in src/pack.ts and src/install-claude.ts, per INTERFACE.md §1.1's CommandLineToArgvW rule) — npm/npx are .cmd shims on Windows and Node >= 20.12 no longer auto-resolves them.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cd5-f75d-7e63-9082-ac1b43c2c2df:Skill-pack names (from a pack's wicked-pack.json manifest) must be validated against the kebab-case SAFE_NAME regex (^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, max 64 chars) before being used as a filesystem path segment (install home, ~/.claude/skills copy destination, remove target). This prevents a hostile/malformed manifest's "name" field from path-traversing (e.g. "../../") out of the packs directory. Enforced today in src/pack.ts's assertSafeName(); apply the same check to any new code path that derives a filesystem path from pack- or registry-supplied data.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cd5-ff1f-77a2-9334-028397601011:Any binary/command name sourced from registry.json (install.package, install.crate, install.crates[]) must be validated against the SAFE_BINARY regex (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$) before being passed to commandExists()/execSync(), because registry.json ships inside the package and can be hand-edited or corrupted — an unvalidated name like "x; rm -rf ~" would otherwise reach a shell. Enforced today via commandExistsSafe() in src/detector.ts; apply the same guard to any new code path that shells out using a name read from registry.json.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cdb-bc19-7351-adcb-61585e03c9ec:Never mutate a landed _vN.html after it is recorded in versions.json. wicked-interactive document versions are write-once (INV-4, ADR-0008) — a fix or edit must always produce a new version number, never rewrite an existing one, even for a 'small correction'.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cdb-c3c9-7a31-8dd6-40aa5f58fa3d:Never hard-delete a wicked-interactive document. Retirement (DELETE /api/docs/:doc) is a SOFT tombstone only (retired_at stamped on versions.json, AC-22) — the lineage stays on disk for audit and the doc name stays permanently reserved so a recreated doc of the same name can never silently inherit an old audit trail.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cdb-cc78-7352-a50a-4365c65f605e:Any code that produces or edits version HTML in wicked-interactive must preserve data-wid anchors (INV-1/INV-2). A structural-edit fragment that drops its data-wid is rejected by the regenerate() gate in core/regenerate.js — never bypass or weaken that gate to land content that lost its anchor.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cdb-d4ac-7932-b608-c605344361ed:Never emit or accept a wicked-bus event type in wicked-interactive without first registering it in the EVENT_TYPES owner/producer table in src/service/events.js. emitEvent() (src/service/bus-client.js) validates every emit against that table before it touches the bus — adding a new event type or allowing a new producer to emit an existing one requires updating events.js first, not just the call site.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07ce3-6723-7a52-852c-b95b1d47abe3:Every durable write in wicked-vault (config, payload blob, entry, attestation, contract, supersede state-flip) MUST go through atomicWriteFileSync (src/vault/vault.mjs): write to a unique temp file in the SAME directory, then rename over the destination, with a win32 EPERM/EEXIST/EACCES/EBUSY unlink-then-rename fallback and bounded retry. Do not add a direct writeFileSync onto a real vault path.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07ce3-7750-7771-b517-b111353c6314:record() enforces payload_max_bytes (fail-closed, G5) BEFORE hashing or writing the blob — an oversize capture must produce NO entry and NO payload blob, never a partial write. Any refactor of the record() capture path must keep the size check ahead of both sha256() and atomicWriteFileSync().

conform:Error:proposal:01a07ce3-7ef5-7013-be0c-0396afe71100:supersede() must write and confirm-on-disk the NEW replacement entry before flipping the OLD entry's state to 'superseded' (crash-safe append-only ordering, G6). Never reorder this so the old entry is invalidated before the new one is durably confirmed — a crash mid-sequence must at worst leave both entries briefly active, never zero active entries.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07bbd-98a2-7040-b464-e84791886cfe:Callers of scripts/crew/archetypes_v11.py detect_archetypes() must treat a result where 'triage' is the only match as a signal to ask a clarifying question, not as license to silently dispatch.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07bc7-56a1-71e1-9753-f639616e72f9:When submitting a proposal.submit payload, use tier/severity values from the exact fixed enum sets (tier: working/episodic/semantic/procedural/archival; severity: info/warn/error/critical) — never invent a value like 'durable' or 'warning'; the server now fails fast on an out-of-enum value rather than accepting it.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07bf9-8d37-7691-b13f-2da22e97ec0c:Any change to src/service/server.js (createServer, createMultiServer, mountDoc, onCommand, runCommand, bootstrap, serviceEmit, drainPendingRetireEvent) must be validated against the full test/*.test.js suite (the shared `boot()` helpers), not just tests local to the change. Estate BlastRadius analysis shows 47-53 transitive dependents fanning out from this file's core symbols — the highest of any symbol in the repo — so a change here is far more likely to break something distant than a change elsewhere.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07c52-1ba0-7662-81ee-a2014ba927f0:crossCheck() in src/vault/vault.mjs must stay a pure function of (declared contract, recorded artifacts) — it decides WHETHER a contract is satisfied, never WHAT the contract should require. Claim authoring, work-shape, or archetype policy belongs in a consumer (wicked-garden), not in this function. If a contract is missing, crossCheck must fail-closed (return overall:'ERROR'), never assume a default set of required claims.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07c57-130e-75d3-8b25-1adf423ad3e8:In src/hooks/useRoute.ts, a genuinely unmatched/typo'd address must parse to panel:'not-found'. Only addresses for KNOWN retired surfaces may be folded into a replacement panel at parse time, and only if a companion use*Redirect hook (useSteeringRedirect / useTestingRedirect / useRetiredSettingsRedirect / useLegacyRedirect) then normalizes the URL via history.replaceState. Never silently swap an arbitrary unrecognized path onto a valid panel.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07ccc-992f-7cf1-badf-b506f9c8bf46:Treat lib/errors.js as the authoritative source for wicked-bus's current WBError code count, not CLAUDE.md's 'Six error codes: WB-001 through WB-006' line. As of this audit (2026-09), lib/errors.js defines thirteen codes, WB-001..WB-013 -- WB-007 (LARGE_SCAN_REJECTED) through WB-013 (SPILL_BUCKET_UNAVAILABLE) are v2 additions per DESIGN-v2.md §10.2 that postdate the CLAUDE.md doc. Any future CLAUDE.md refresh or error-handling review should reconcile this count.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07ccc-adc7-7422-b7b4-e63971d32f42:Any new numeric config.json key that feeds a background timer interval (setInterval/setTimeout) must be passed through lib/config.js's coerceInterval() pattern before use, not read raw from the merged config object.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07cd5-ea2a-7a72-ba77-d5cfffd109a1:Each per-CLI install script (src/install-<cli>.ts) must remain self-contained — no imports from other src/ modules, node: builtins only — because each one is shipped and executed standalone as dist/install-<cli>.js, discovered at runtime by index.ts's discoverCliScripts(). Shared logic changes (e.g. marker-file format, config-dir resolution) must be replicated by hand into every install-<cli>.ts rather than factored into a shared import.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07cdb-dc66-7361-a09b-97f46e55779e:All mutations to a wicked-interactive document workspace (feedback, structural edits, drafts, forks, retirement) must run through the per-document FIFO queue (`enqueue` in createServer, src/service/server.js, ADR-0007). Writing versions.json or a _vN.html file outside that queue risks a race between two concurrent regenerations on the manifest.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07cdf-dcbc-7f02-b004-0702a2adb011:src/components/LeftSidebar.tsx's rail sections fetch data on accordion EXPAND only, never on a poll interval or on mount — the Repositories accordion shares the palette's session-scoped repo cache (one GET /repos per session, gesture-driven) and the old 5s repo poll was deliberately retired. Everything else the rail renders reads data the app already holds (the `runs` prop, the board model, existing zustand stores). A new rail section or heading-level action must follow this same fetch-on-expand discipline rather than introducing its own polling loop.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07ce3-85bb-7a92-b7e6-9cb540a26e16:A verifier in src/vault/verifiers.mjs's VERIFIERS registry must remain a PURE, deterministic function of (payload-view, params) -> {status, detail} (G7) — no reliance on wall-clock time, network, or non-reproducible state. commit_exists/jq_pred subprocess calls are the accepted exception (git/jq are treated as deterministic oracles), but any new verifier kind must not introduce nondeterminism or hidden I/O beyond that pattern.

rules.statement: 01a07bbd-887f-7110-9edc-7fb627d35820:scripts/qe/vault_gate.py resolve_vault()'s run-the-vault path (allow_npx=True) must remain loom-authoritative with no in-process fallback: if wicked-loom is unresolvable, disabled, or errors, resolve_vault must return None so the downstream gate fails closed rather than producing a vacuous pass.

01a07bc6-fedc-71b0-b2ba-cd554a95c73b:Never key a graph node by content hash or line number; identity must route through SymbolId (ADR-002). A change that introduces a content-hash- or line-derived node id is a regression of the rename-safety invariant.

01a07bc7-0d50-70f0-b9b9-a94222268c60:index_path's delete-sweep must scope 'previously indexed' strictly to file paths carrying a digest row this indexer wrote (indexed_files()), never to the full node population (all_nodes()) — a shared store can hold non-file domain objects that must never be swept by a subdirectory reindex (FINDING-067).

01a07bc7-2f63-79b2-9aef-2bdc705808fe:Every write/destructive MCP tool must be both omitted from tools/list under --readonly AND refused by name inside the tools/call dispatch backstop (is_write_tool check) before any domain dispatch runs — a new write tool that skips either layer is a --readonly bypass.

01a07cdb-e555-70e0-bdc1-675ec1149bf7:Any new wicked-interactive feature that fetches a user-supplied URL server-side must reuse the SSRF guard pattern in src/service/theme-grab.js (assertPublicUrl + resolveRedirectChain): validate the initial host AND every redirect hop before rendering, and pin the validated IP into the browser launch (--host-resolver-rules) to prevent DNS-rebinding between validation and fetch. Never hand a raw user-supplied URL straight to a headless browser or fetch call.

01a07ce3-6fcb-7a63-b60b-4dee98dbed38:attest() must refuse a self-grade (G10/D4): the evaluator identity must be a deliberately-asserted, non-ambient identity (not bare $USER/anonymous) and must differ from the artifact's created_by. Any change to attest()'s identity-resolution logic (resolveActor, WEAK_IDENTITY_SOURCES) must preserve this fail-closed behavior rather than weakening it for convenience.
01a07b85-e09f-77e0-93fa-df59c0525b06:wicked-interactive bridge spawns must use an explicit pinned npm version/range, never a bare `npx --yes wicked-interactive`.

01a07bb2-ee1f-7a21-a759-3520a2a2213a:In CoreAdapter's constructor, WICKED_BUS_EXEC/WICKED_BUS_DB must be set before Core.spawn()/Core.spawnStub() is called, never after or conditionally reordered — the Rust actor only reads them at spawn time, so a reordering silently disables the bus-exec event-mediation seam instead of failing loudly.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07ce3-85bb-7a92-b7e6-9cb540a26e16:A verifier in src/vault/verifiers.mjs's VERIFIERS registry must remain a PURE, deterministic function of (payload-view, params) -> {status, detail} (G7) — no reliance on wall-clock time, network, or non-reproducible state. commit_exists/jq_pred subprocess calls are the accepted exception (git/jq are treated as deterministic oracles), but any new verifier kind must not introduce nondeterminism or hidden I/O beyond that pattern.

rules.statement: 01a07bbd-887f-7110-9edc-7fb627d35820:scripts/qe/vault_gate.py resolve_vault()'s run-the-vault path (allow_npx=True) must remain loom-authoritative with no in-process fallback: if wicked-loom is unresolvable, disabled, or errors, resolve_vault must return None so the downstream gate fails closed rather than producing a vacuous pass.

01a07bc6-fedc-71b0-b2ba-cd554a95c73b:Never key a graph node by content hash or line number; identity must route through SymbolId (ADR-002). A change that introduces a content-hash- or line-derived node id is a regression of the rename-safety invariant.

01a07bc7-0d50-70f0-b9b9-a94222268c60:index_path's delete-sweep must scope 'previously indexed' strictly to file paths carrying a digest row this indexer wrote (indexed_files()), never to the full node population (all_nodes()) — a shared store can hold non-file domain objects that must never be swept by a subdirectory reindex (FINDING-067).

01a07bc7-2f63-79b2-9aef-2bdc705808fe:Every write/destructive MCP tool must be both omitted from tools/list under --readonly AND refused by name inside the tools/call dispatch backstop (is_write_tool check) before any domain dispatch runs — a new write tool that skips either layer is a --readonly bypass.

01a07cdb-e555-70e0-bdc1-675ec1149bf7:Any new wicked-interactive feature that fetches a user-supplied URL server-side must reuse the SSRF guard pattern in src/service/theme-grab.js (assertPublicUrl + resolveRedirectChain): validate the initial host AND every redirect hop before rendering, and pin the validated IP into the browser launch (--host-resolver-rules) to prevent DNS-rebinding between validation and fetch. Never hand a raw user-supplied URL straight to a headless browser or fetch call.

01a07ce3-6fcb-7a63-b60b-4dee98dbed38:attest() must refuse a self-grade (G10/D4): the evaluator identity must be a deliberately-asserted, non-ambient identity (not bare $USER/anonymous) and must differ from the artifact's created_by. Any change to attest()'s identity-resolution logic (resolveActor, WEAK_IDENTITY_SOURCES) must preserve this fail-closed behavior rather than weakening it for convenience.
01a07b85-e09f-77e0-93fa-df59c0525b06:wicked-interactive bridge spawns must use an explicit pinned npm version/range, never a bare `npx --yes wicked-interactive`.

01a07bb2-ee1f-7a21-a759-3520a2a2213a:In CoreAdapter's constructor, WICKED_BUS_EXEC/WICKED_BUS_DB must be set before Core.spawn()/Core.spawnStub() is called, never after or conditionally reordered — the Rust actor only reads them at spawn time, so a reordering silently disables the bus-exec event-mediation seam instead of failing loudly.

01a07bb2-fc20-7dc3-8b6a-c02420eab60a:Request-handling code in packages/crew/src/api/{routes,server}.ts must never spawn git synchronously on the request path (e.g. for delivery/vacuity state) — it must read the background-swept DeliveryDerivationCache and degrade to the stat-only tri-state on a miss, to keep GET /runs latency bounded.

01a07bb3-0ac2-7f10-af4c-67db2da4f49f:Any shape that crosses the daemon's /api/v1 or /ws boundary belongs in packages/crew-api-types/index.d.ts, never duplicated ad hoc in packages/crew/src/core/types.ts or packages/studio/src/api/types.ts — packages/crew/tests/wire-contract.test.ts is the compile-time drift guard and must keep passing.

01a07bbd-4224-7eb2-9978-670ddff3a768:scripts/_bus.py emit_event() must never block or raise on its caller: an unknown event_type must be a silent no-op and bus-emission failures must degrade silently (fire-and-forget via a daemon thread), never propagate.

01a07bbd-4efa-7021-9e3c-0a9260630c89:scripts/_session.py SessionState.load() must never raise: a missing file or invalid/corrupt JSON must degrade to a fresh default-valued SessionState, and unknown persisted keys must be ignored rather than rejected, so hook scripts can call it unconditionally.

01a07bbd-64a3-77a1-9c14-d5ab3a9987fa:SessionStart hooks (hooks/scripts/bootstrap.py) must fail open when a required peer (e.g. the estate binary) is unavailable: session start must never block or crash because a peer is missing.

01a07bbd-7105-7210-b2bc-c45014eb89dd:scripts/_event_store.py EventStore.append() must swallow all exceptions and return None on failure rather than propagate, so event logging can never crash a caller.

01a07bbd-8ee5-77d2-8f50-b0eb0e6aa653:scripts/qe/vault_gate.py resolve_vault()'s concrete-install probe (allow_npx=False, used by vault_available) must never consult wicked-loom, so an npx-resolvable-but-not-installed vault can't be misreported as concretely installed.

01a07bc7-1e55-7912-a06f-ccaf8277426b:Any indexing gate that forces a full re-extraction (version, rules-digest, plugin-override, id-scheme, or a future one) must write its certifying meta key only after the re-extraction durably completes, never at detection time — so a crash mid-migration re-fires the gate instead of falsely certifying a mixed-state store.

01a07bc7-46fd-7133-8e1e-4c9a004a5f05:Never call Connection::open(":memory:") a second time to reach an existing XedgeStore overlay; always share the existing Arc<Mutex<Connection>> (via clone or XedgeStore::reader()), since a fresh open of an in-memory SQLite path yields a distinct, silently-empty database.

01a07bf9-93a8-7c63-8c05-e4f6bdbd6bcb:When adding a new event type to src/service/events.js's EVENT_TYPES table, also update the corresponding event-schemas/ definition (per the module's own header comment: 'Keep this table and event-schemas/ in lockstep'). The ownership/uiEmittable whitelist and the schema must stay in sync — a mismatch would silently break the loop-safety and UI-emit-whitelist guarantees the entire wicked-interactive control plane relies on.

01a07c36-4cfb-76e0-9f5a-7f6d507d18b0:In DomainStore.create()/update(), the canonical JSON write must throw on failure (never swallow); a SQLite index write failure must never throw and must only increment the drift counter and log — SQLite is a rebuildable index, not the source of truth.

01a07c36-558b-7391-9beb-968e72cc9f9d:DomainStore._initDb must refuse to open (throw, close, null out this._db) any store database whose schema_migrations max version exceeds the running code's SCHEMA_VERSION — never write against a DB produced by a newer wicked-ledger version.

01a07c36-5be4-7fc1-b5af-000870396103:wicked-ledger migrations (lib/migrations/*.sql) must be additive-only and applied inside a single transaction per file (schema DDL + schema_migrations bookkeeping insert together) — never edit or renumber an already-shipped migration file.

01a07c36-6235-7802-95be-2d38d037444a:emitBusEvent (lib/bus-emit.mjs) must never throw or otherwise block a DomainStore write — bus delivery is best-effort; any failure to reach the wicked-bus CLI must be caught and reported as a boolean, not propagated.

01a07c36-68d2-7c42-9638-8c67e451de8c:validateScenarioEvidence must reject a scenario_evidence payload whose overall claim_level ranks stronger than its weakest per-leg claim_level — the aggregate claim must never overstate the proof quality of its weakest step.

01a07c36-6e51-7850-9f5e-6e53caf44196:assertRuntimeSupported must keep throwing ERR_WICKED_RUNTIME_TEAM_UNSUPPORTED for WICKED_RUNTIME=team until a real shared-store driver replaces the JSON + better-sqlite3 store — never let 'team' mode silently fall back to producing engineer-local state under a shared-state label.

01a07c52-139b-7260-9412-f8e58febf7b6:supersede() in src/vault/vault.mjs must keep its crash-safe write ordering: (1) record the replacement artifact fully, (2) confirm the new entry file exists on disk, (3) only then flip the old entry's state to 'superseded'. Never flip the old entry first or write both in a single unguarded step — a crash between steps must never leave the old entry inactive with no active replacement (worst case tolerated: both briefly 'active', which cross-check's 'latest active wins' rule already handles).

01a07c56-e5df-7ed1-8e05-a65130152099:Any new fetch wrapper (parallel to apiFetch in src/api/client.ts or iFetch in src/api/interactive.ts) must omit the Content-Type: application/json header when the request has no body, not send it unconditionally.

01a07c56-f241-7b41-b7d4-86178e729a9a:Never render ApiError.wire (the daemon's raw error sentence) directly in the UI, and never string-match/parse it in tests or app code. Always go through translateWireError's output (ApiError.message) for display, and assert on the typed .status / .wire fields in tests.

01a07ccc-a5ed-7061-8e97-976c0ca44ce6:Filter-matching logic in lib/poll.js is intentionally duplicated across two functions -- matchesFilter() (in-memory, used by the daemon's in-process broadcast path) and buildFilterSql() (SQL LIKE-based, used by poll()'s query) -- and both must be kept semantically identical. Any change to wildcard semantics (single-level 'prefix.*' vs multi-level 'prefix.**' vs catch-all '*', or the domain '@domain' suffix) must be applied to both functions, including buildFilterSql's ESCAPE '\\' handling for literal '_'/'%'/'\\' inside event_type prefixes.

01a07cd0-fabf-7403-b7ab-ed1f898455a9:Never add crates/wicked-core-ts to the root Cargo.toml [workspace].members list (or otherwise fold it into the main cargo workspace). It must stay in the workspace's `exclude` list.

01a07cd5-df93-73b2-a84d-820432495ba0:Any code that spawns npm or npx (or the wicked-garden bin) on Windows must set { shell: true } on spawnSync AND cmd.exe-quote every argument (see winQuote() in src/pack.ts and src/install-claude.ts, per INTERFACE.md §1.1's CommandLineToArgvW rule) — npm/npx are .cmd shims on Windows and Node >= 20.12 no longer auto-resolves them.

01a07cd5-f75d-7e63-9082-ac1b43c2c2df:Skill-pack names (from a pack's wicked-pack.json manifest) must be validated against the kebab-case SAFE_NAME regex (^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, max 64 chars) before being used as a filesystem path segment (install home, ~/.claude/skills copy destination, remove target). This prevents a hostile/malformed manifest's "name" field from path-traversing (e.g. "../../") out of the packs directory. Enforced today in src/pack.ts's assertSafeName(); apply the same check to any new code path that derives a filesystem path from pack- or registry-supplied data.

01a07cd5-ff1f-77a2-9334-028397601011:Any binary/command name sourced from registry.json (install.package, install.crate, install.crates[]) must be validated against the SAFE_BINARY regex (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$) before being passed to commandExists()/execSync(), because registry.json ships inside the package and can be hand-edited or corrupted — an unvalidated name like "x; rm -rf ~" would otherwise reach a shell. Enforced today via commandExistsSafe() in src/detector.ts; apply the same guard to any new code path that shells out using a name read from registry.json.

01a07cdb-bc19-7351-adcb-61585e03c9ec:Never mutate a landed _vN.html after it is recorded in versions.json. wicked-interactive document versions are write-once (INV-4, ADR-0008) — a fix or edit must always produce a new version number, never rewrite an existing one, even for a 'small correction'.

01a07cdb-c3c9-7a31-8dd6-40aa5f58fa3d:Never hard-delete a wicked-interactive document. Retirement (DELETE /api/docs/:doc) is a SOFT tombstone only (retired_at stamped on versions.json, AC-22) — the lineage stays on disk for audit and the doc name stays permanently reserved so a recreated doc of the same name can never silently inherit an old audit trail.

01a07cdb-cc78-7352-a50a-4365c65f605e:Any code that produces or edits version HTML in wicked-interactive must preserve data-wid anchors (INV-1/INV-2). A structural-edit fragment that drops its data-wid is rejected by the regenerate() gate in core/regenerate.js — never bypass or weaken that gate to land content that lost its anchor.

01a07cdb-d4ac-7932-b608-c605344361ed:Never emit or accept a wicked-bus event type in wicked-interactive without first registering it in the EVENT_TYPES owner/producer table in src/service/events.js. emitEvent() (src/service/bus-client.js) validates every emit against that table before it touches the bus — adding a new event type or allowing a new producer to emit an existing one requires updating events.js first, not just the call site.

01a07ce3-6723-7a52-852c-b95b1d47abe3:Every durable write in wicked-vault (config, payload blob, entry, attestation, contract, supersede state-flip) MUST go through atomicWriteFileSync (src/vault/vault.mjs): write to a unique temp file in the SAME directory, then rename over the destination, with a win32 EPERM/EEXIST/EACCES/EBUSY unlink-then-rename fallback and bounded retry. Do not add a direct writeFileSync onto a real vault path.

01a07ce3-7750-7771-b517-b111353c6314:record() enforces payload_max_bytes (fail-closed, G5) BEFORE hashing or writing the blob — an oversize capture must produce NO entry and NO payload blob, never a partial write. Any refactor of the record() capture path must keep the size check ahead of both sha256() and atomicWriteFileSync().

01a07ce3-7ef5-7013-be0c-0396afe71100:supersede() must write and confirm-on-disk the NEW replacement entry before flipping the OLD entry's state to 'superseded' (crash-safe append-only ordering, G6). Never reorder this so the old entry is invalidated before the new one is durably confirmed — a crash mid-sequence must at worst leave both entries briefly active, never zero active entries.

01a07bbd-98a2-7040-b464-e84791886cfe:Callers of scripts/crew/archetypes_v11.py detect_archetypes() must treat a result where 'triage' is the only match as a signal to ask a clarifying question, not as license to silently dispatch.

01a07bc7-56a1-71e1-9753-f639616e72f9:When submitting a proposal.submit payload, use tier/severity values from the exact fixed enum sets (tier: working/episodic/semantic/procedural/archival; severity: info/warn/error/critical) — never invent a value like 'durable' or 'warning'; the server now fails fast on an out-of-enum value rather than accepting it.

01a07bf9-8d37-7691-b13f-2da22e97ec0c:Any change to src/service/server.js (createServer, createMultiServer, mountDoc, onCommand, runCommand, bootstrap, serviceEmit, drainPendingRetireEvent) must be validated against the full test/*.test.js suite (the shared `boot()` helpers), not just tests local to the change. Estate BlastRadius analysis shows 47-53 transitive dependents fanning out from this file's core symbols — the highest of any symbol in the repo — so a change here is far more likely to break something distant than a change elsewhere.

01a07c52-1ba0-7662-81ee-a2014ba927f0:crossCheck() in src/vault/vault.mjs must stay a pure function of (declared contract, recorded artifacts) — it decides WHETHER a contract is satisfied, never WHAT the contract should require. Claim authoring, work-shape, or archetype policy belongs in a consumer (wicked-garden), not in this function. If a contract is missing, crossCheck must fail-closed (return overall:'ERROR'), never assume a default set of required claims.

01a07c57-130e-75d3-8b25-1adf423ad3e8:In src/hooks/useRoute.ts, a genuinely unmatched/typo'd address must parse to panel:'not-found'. Only addresses for KNOWN retired surfaces may be folded into a replacement panel at parse time, and only if a companion use*Redirect hook (useSteeringRedirect / useTestingRedirect / useRetiredSettingsRedirect / useLegacyRedirect) then normalizes the URL via history.replaceState. Never silently swap an arbitrary unrecognized path onto a valid panel.

01a07ccc-992f-7cf1-badf-b506f9c8bf46:Treat lib/errors.js as the authoritative source for wicked-bus's current WBError code count, not CLAUDE.md's 'Six error codes: WB-001 through WB-006' line. As of this audit (2026-09), lib/errors.js defines thirteen codes, WB-001..WB-013 -- WB-007 (LARGE_SCAN_REJECTED) through WB-013 (SPILL_BUCKET_UNAVAILABLE) are v2 additions per DESIGN-v2.md §10.2 that postdate the CLAUDE.md doc. Any future CLAUDE.md refresh or error-handling review should reconcile this count.

01a07ccc-adc7-7422-b7b4-e63971d32f42:Any new numeric config.json key that feeds a background timer interval (setInterval/setTimeout) must be passed through lib/config.js's coerceInterval() pattern before use, not read raw from the merged config object.

01a07cd5-ea2a-7a72-ba77-d5cfffd109a1:Each per-CLI install script (src/install-<cli>.ts) must remain self-contained — no imports from other src/ modules, node: builtins only — because each one is shipped and executed standalone as dist/install-<cli>.js, discovered at runtime by index.ts's discoverCliScripts(). Shared logic changes (e.g. marker-file format, config-dir resolution) must be replicated by hand into every install-<cli>.ts rather than factored into a shared import.

01a07cdb-dc66-7361-a09b-97f46e55779e:All mutations to a wicked-interactive document workspace (feedback, structural edits, drafts, forks, retirement) must run through the per-document FIFO queue (`enqueue` in createServer, src/service/server.js, ADR-0007). Writing versions.json or a _vN.html file outside that queue risks a race between two concurrent regenerations on the manifest.

01a07cdf-dcbc-7f02-b004-0702a2adb011:src/components/LeftSidebar.tsx's rail sections fetch data on accordion EXPAND only, never on a poll interval or on mount — the Repositories accordion shares the palette's session-scoped repo cache (one GET /repos per session, gesture-driven) and the old 5s repo poll was deliberately retired. Everything else the rail renders reads data the app already holds (the `runs` prop, the board model, existing zustand stores). A new rail section or heading-level action must follow this same fetch-on-expand discipline rather than introducing its own polling loop.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07c52-139b-7260-9412-f8e58febf7b6:supersede() in src/vault/vault.mjs must keep its crash-safe write ordering: (1) record the replacement artifact fully, (2) confirm the new entry file exists on disk, (3) only then flip the old entry's state to 'superseded'. Never flip the old entry first or write both in a single unguarded step — a crash between steps must never leave the old entry inactive with no active replacement (worst case tolerated: both briefly 'active', which cross-check's 'latest active wins' rule already handles).

conform:Error:proposal:01a07c56-e5df-7ed1-8e05-a65130152099:Any new fetch wrapper (parallel to apiFetch in src/api/client.ts or iFetch in src/api/interactive.ts) must omit the Content-Type: application/json header when the request has no body, not send it unconditionally.

Always go through translateWireError's output (ApiError.message) for display, and assert on the typed .status / .wire fields in tests.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07ccc-a5ed-7061-8e97-976c0ca44ce6:Filter-matching logic in lib/poll.js is intentionally duplicated across two functions -- matchesFilter() (in-memory, used by the daemon's in-process broadcast path) and buildFilterSql() (SQL LIKE-based, used by poll()'s query) -- and both must be kept semantically identical. Any change to wildcard semantics (single-level 'prefix.*' vs multi-level 'prefix.**' vs catch-all '*', or the domain '@domain' suffix) must be applied to both functions, including buildFilterSql's ESCAPE '\\' handling for literal '_'/'%'/'\\' inside event_type prefixes.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cd0-fabf-7403-b7ab-ed1f898455a9:Never add crates/wicked-core-ts to the root Cargo.toml [workspace].members list (or otherwise fold it into the main cargo workspace). It must stay in the workspace's `exclude` list.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cd5-df93-73b2-a84d-820432495ba0:Any code that spawns npm or npx (or the wicked-garden bin) on Windows must set { shell: true } on spawnSync AND cmd.exe-quote every argument (see winQuote() in src/pack.ts and src/install-claude.ts, per INTERFACE.md §1.1's CommandLineToArgvW rule) — npm/npx are .cmd shims on Windows and Node >= 20.12 no longer auto-resolves them.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cd5-f75d-7e63-9082-ac1b43c2c2df:Skill-pack names (from a pack's wicked-pack.json manifest) must be validated against the kebab-case SAFE_NAME regex (^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, max 64 chars) before being used as a filesystem path segment (install home, ~/.claude/skills copy destination, remove target). This prevents a hostile/malformed manifest's "name" field from path-traversing (e.g. "../../") out of the packs directory. Enforced today in src/pack.ts's assertSafeName(); apply the same check to any new code path that derives a filesystem path from pack- or registry-supplied data.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cd5-ff1f-77a2-9334-028397601011:Any binary/command name sourced from registry.json (install.package, install.crate, install.crates[]) must be validated against the SAFE_BINARY regex (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$) before being passed to commandExists()/execSync(), because registry.json ships inside the package and can be hand-edited or corrupted — an unvalidated name like "x; rm -rf ~" would otherwise reach a shell. Enforced today via commandExistsSafe() in src/detector.ts; apply the same guard to any new code path that shells out using a name read from registry.json.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cdb-bc19-7351-adcb-61585e03c9ec:Never mutate a landed _vN.html after it is recorded in versions.json. wicked-interactive document versions are write-once (INV-4, ADR-0008) — a fix or edit must always produce a new version number, never rewrite an existing one, even for a 'small correction'.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cdb-c3c9-7a31-8dd6-40aa5f58fa3d:Never hard-delete a wicked-interactive document. Retirement (DELETE /api/docs/:doc) is a SOFT tombstone only (retired_at stamped on versions.json, AC-22) — the lineage stays on disk for audit and the doc name stays permanently reserved so a recreated doc of the same name can never silently inherit an old audit trail.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cdb-cc78-7352-a50a-4365c65f605e:Any code that produces or edits version HTML in wicked-interactive must preserve data-wid anchors (INV-1/INV-2). A structural-edit fragment that drops its data-wid is rejected by the regenerate() gate in core/regenerate.js — never bypass or weaken that gate to land content that lost its anchor.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07cdb-d4ac-7932-b608-c605344361ed:Never emit or accept a wicked-bus event type in wicked-interactive without first registering it in the EVENT_TYPES owner/producer table in src/service/events.js. emitEvent() (src/service/bus-client.js) validates every emit against that table before it touches the bus — adding a new event type or allowing a new producer to emit an existing one requires updating events.js first, not just the call site.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07ce3-6723-7a52-852c-b95b1d47abe3:Every durable write in wicked-vault (config, payload blob, entry, attestation, contract, supersede state-flip) MUST go through atomicWriteFileSync (src/vault/vault.mjs): write to a unique temp file in the SAME directory, then rename over the destination, with a win32 EPERM/EEXIST/EACCES/EBUSY unlink-then-rename fallback and bounded retry. Do not add a direct writeFileSync onto a real vault path.

conform:Error:proposal:01a07ce3-7750-7771-b517-b111353c6314:record() enforces payload_max_bytes (fail-closed, G5) BEFORE hashing or writing the blob — an oversize capture must produce NO entry and NO payload blob, never a partial write. Any refactor of the record() capture path must keep the size check ahead of both sha256() and atomicWriteFileSync().

conform:Error:proposal:01a07ce3-7ef5-7013-be0c-0396afe71100:supersede() must write and confirm-on-disk the NEW replacement entry before flipping the OLD entry's state to 'superseded' (crash-safe append-only ordering, G6). Never reorder this so the old entry is invalidated before the new one is durably confirmed — a crash mid-sequence must at worst leave both entries briefly active, never zero active entries.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07bbd-98a2-7040-b464-e84791886cfe:Callers of scripts/crew/archetypes_v11.py detect_archetypes() must treat a result where 'triage' is the only match as a signal to ask a clarifying question, not as license to silently dispatch.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07bc7-56a1-71e1-9753-f639616e72f9:When submitting a proposal.submit payload, use tier/severity values from the exact fixed enum sets (tier: working/episodic/semantic/procedural/archival; severity: info/warn/error/critical) — never invent a value like 'durable' or 'warning'; the server now fails fast on an out-of-enum value rather than accepting it.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07bf9-8d37-7691-b13f-2da22e97ec0c:Any change to src/service/server.js (createServer, createMultiServer, mountDoc, onCommand, runCommand, bootstrap, serviceEmit, drainPendingRetireEvent) must be validated against the full test/*.test.js suite (the shared `boot()` helpers), not just tests local to the change. Estate BlastRadius analysis shows 47-53 transitive dependents fanning out from this file's core symbols — the highest of any symbol in the repo — so a change here is far more likely to break something distant than a change elsewhere.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07c52-1ba0-7662-81ee-a2014ba927f0:crossCheck() in src/vault/vault.mjs must stay a pure function of (declared contract, recorded artifacts) — it decides WHETHER a contract is satisfied, never WHAT the contract should require. Claim authoring, work-shape, or archetype policy belongs in a consumer (wicked-garden), not in this function. If a contract is missing, crossCheck must fail-closed (return overall:'ERROR'), never assume a default set of required claims.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07c57-130e-75d3-8b25-1adf423ad3e8:In src/hooks/useRoute.ts, a genuinely unmatched/typo'd address must parse to panel:'not-found'. Only addresses for KNOWN retired surfaces may be folded into a replacement panel at parse time, and only if a companion use*Redirect hook (useSteeringRedirect / useTestingRedirect / useRetiredSettingsRedirect / useLegacyRedirect) then normalizes the URL via history.replaceState. Never silently swap an arbitrary unrecognized path onto a valid panel.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07ccc-992f-7cf1-badf-b506f9c8bf46:Treat lib/errors.js as the authoritative source for wicked-bus's current WBError code count, not CLAUDE.md's 'Six error codes: WB-001 through WB-006' line. As of this audit (2026-09), lib/errors.js defines thirteen codes, WB-001..WB-013 -- WB-007 (LARGE_SCAN_REJECTED) through WB-013 (SPILL_BUCKET_UNAVAILABLE) are v2 additions per DESIGN-v2.md §10.2 that postdate the CLAUDE.md doc. Any future CLAUDE.md refresh or error-handling review should reconcile this count.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07ccc-adc7-7422-b7b4-e63971d32f42:Any new numeric config.json key that feeds a background timer interval (setInterval/setTimeout) must be passed through lib/config.js's coerceInterval() pattern before use, not read raw from the merged config object.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07cd5-ea2a-7a72-ba77-d5cfffd109a1:Each per-CLI install script (src/install-<cli>.ts) must remain self-contained — no imports from other src/ modules, node: builtins only — because each one is shipped and executed standalone as dist/install-<cli>.js, discovered at runtime by index.ts's discoverCliScripts(). Shared logic changes (e.g. marker-file format, config-dir resolution) must be replicated by hand into every install-<cli>.ts rather than factored into a shared import.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07cdb-dc66-7361-a09b-97f46e55779e:All mutations to a wicked-interactive document workspace (feedback, structural edits, drafts, forks, retirement) must run through the per-document FIFO queue (`enqueue` in createServer, src/service/server.js, ADR-0007). Writing versions.json or a _vN.html file outside that queue risks a race between two concurrent regenerations on the manifest.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07cdf-dcbc-7f02-b004-0702a2adb011:src/components/LeftSidebar.tsx's rail sections fetch data on accordion EXPAND only, never on a poll interval or on mount — the Repositories accordion shares the palette's session-scoped repo cache (one GET /repos per session, gesture-driven) and the old 5s repo poll was deliberately retired. Everything else the rail renders reads data the app already holds (the `runs` prop, the board model, existing zustand stores). A new rail section or heading-level action must follow this same fetch-on-expand discipline rather than introducing its own polling loop.

conform:Warn:proposal:01a07ce3-85bb-7a92-b7e6-9cb540a26e16:A verifier in src/vault/verifiers.mjs's VERIFIERS registry must remain a PURE, deterministic function of (payload-view, params) -> {status, detail} (G7) — no reliance on wall-clock time, network, or non-reproducible state. commit_exists/jq_pred subprocess calls are the accepted exception (git/jq are treated as deterministic oracles), but any new verifier kind must not introduce nondeterminism or hidden I/O beyond that pattern.
